notes.subject: ויחל
notes.rationale: Tok Hibru i tok 'em i stat long senisim olgeta' — ol tanim i tok 'wundim' (KJV), 'pen tru' (ASV), o 'kirap nogut' — tok i tok long taim i nogut tru, i no klia olsem wund.

notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Pronoun ⟨em⟩ bilong tokim Saul, we Hibru i bin pulim long tok וימצאהו.

translation: Na pait i kamap hevi moa long Saul, na ol man bilong sutim ba spred i lukim ⟨em⟩ wantaim ba spred, na em i kirap nogut tru long ol man bilong sutim ba spred.

tokens.gloss: ol man bilong sutim ba spred
na em i kirap nogut tru
ol man bilong sutim ba spred
